name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork Burgers with Cheddar-Gruyère Macaroni & Cheese

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE PULLED PORK: Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a 4-quart slow cooker insert.
Add barbecue sauce, broth, vinegar, and liquid smoke to the slow cooker, then whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup barbecue sauce
¼ cup chicken or vegetable broth
¼ cup apple cider vinegar
½ tsp liquid smoke

instructions.primary_message: Place sugar and spices in a small bowl, then stir to combine the spice mix. Rub pork shoulder all over with the spice mix, then transfer to the slow cooker with the sauce. Cover and cook on low until the meat easily shreds with a fork, about 8 hours.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp brown sugar
½ tbsp salt
1 tsp paprika
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp chili powder
2 lb pork shoulder roast, boneless

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE MACARONI & CHEESE: About 30 minutes before the pork is finished, fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, then stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, coarsely grate the cheeses. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oz cheddar cheese
2 oz Gruyère cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another medium saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add flour and whisk until smooth. Cook, whisking frequently, for 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
2 tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Slowly pour half & half and milk into the pan, whisking constantly. Continue whisking until the sauce has thickened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup half & half
½ cup whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Add grated cheese and spices to the pan; whisk until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, 2-3 minutes. Remove cheese sauce from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Drain pasta. Add to the pan with the cheese sauce and stir to combine the macaroni & cheese. Cover to keep warm and set aside.
TO ASSEMBLE THE BURGERS: Preheat oven to broil and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Split buns in half and arrange, cut-side facing up, on a baking sheet pan. Place buns in the oven and toast, flipping once, until golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the pork is done, remove to a cutting board. Shred into bite-sized pieces. (Discard cooking liquid.)
To serve, place bottom half of each bun on a plate; layer with pulled pork, then top with macaroni & cheese. Close with the top half of each bun. Enjoy!
